probe_result: For a finite already-durable same-predecessor candidate set, embedding predecessor_epoch/effect_id/payload_hash in immutable successor self-certificates makes same-effect/same-payload duplicates idempotent and conflicting payloads or distinct effects fail closed without global CAS. A two-record protocol that can make current authoritative before that triple is durable is unsafe. Static restart safety does not close a late-writer race after selection.
mechanism_revision: Collapse intent identity into the immutable successor self-certificate and demote current to advisory cache. Require successor certificate durability before current. This removes the current-before-separate-intent crash gap but does not authorize externally visible effects until the predecessor is closed to late proposals.
scope_guard: Positive evidence is limited to one symbolic certified predecessor e2, two completed successor proposals, three relation classes, and two crash orderings with an enumerable finite restart snapshot. Late writers, incomplete enumeration, irreversible side effects, >2 writers, garbage collection, malicious forgery, and clock/scheduler authority remain untested.

mechanism_assessment.repository_transport_role: bounded role-local immutable certificate persistence/readback only
mechanism_assessment.unresolved_child: Close predecessor e2 to late same-predecessor proposals before any externally visible effect without global CAS, waiting/polling, richer-mode execution, finite monthly quota, or user action.

conflict_check: Semantic inputs were limited to frozen sanitized controls and own neuroscience LATEST/preflight. No O, other-worker, downstream, legacy, shared-ledger, other-role receipt/config, scheduler, protected-primary, hosted-compute, paid, finite-credit, or manual-user execution semantics were used.
exact_next_action: Next valid invocation: checkpoint first, then test exactly one cross-invocation predecessor-closure mechanism. Let predecessor e2 precommit a proposal deadline/slot; successor certificates are proposals only, and a later scheduled invocation may authorize an effect only after the slot is closed and only if every admissible predecessor-bound certificate is equivalent. Stress a late conflicting writer before versus after the precommitted deadline. Determine whether this bounded admission barrier removes the late-writer race without global CAS, same-run waiting/polling, richer-mode execution, finite monthly quota, or user action. If clock/slot authority is insufficient, preserve that blocker and leave a deterministic single-owner precommit as the next alternative.
